text: You ordered from us last season, so you get first pick. Pre-orders are open today with **10% off**, and your box ships the week the season opens on 15 March.
Every box is hand-picked in Ratnagiri and delivered in 48 hours.

blocks.text: Questions? Just reply to this email or [message us on WhatsApp](https://wa.me/919876543210).

blocks.text: All three are the same hand-picked Alphonso. The only question is how many mango lovers you have at home.
Arrived in two days, every single one perfect.
blocks.author: Rahul M., Bengaluru
